mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals worsening supply conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO declines > 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month signals robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases > 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 2.5% in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month indicate labor market deterioration, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a federal funds rate increase signals monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
